evidence.title: Grokking the Object Oriented Design Interview - OOD & Low Level Design (LLD) Course

name: Grokking the Object Oriented Design Interview
summary: Object-oriented design interview course with 22 case studies, 250+ UML diagrams and working code in Python, Java and C++.
description: Course that teaches a repeatable method for object-oriented design (OOD) and low-level design (LLD) interview questions — bound requirements, find classes, connect them, verify the design — then applies it through 22 case studies such as a parking lot, ATM, chess, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn and Amazon, each ending in code that compiles and runs. Covers UML (use case, class, activity, sequence), SOLID and design patterns; 49 lessons and 35 h of study, with adaptive assessments.
